about_the_game:
Hide, sprint, scream—then join the hunt. GRAVE's HALLOWEEN TAG! is a fast, Halloween-themed party-game where the spooks never stop. Start as a Human slipping through a pitch-black graveyard to snatch jack-o-lanterns while dodging your friends who have been turned. Get tagged and you instantly switch sides, joining the ghostly horde that’s chasing down your former teammates. Each catch ramps up the pressure, turning each game into a horror movie!

At launch, the arena is a single, tightly designed map: a shadow-drenched graveyard with a looming church and a twisting bush maze. Light is scarce, your flashlight might just give you away, and there might be surprises waiting around the map to keep nerves frayed as players vanish into darkness or spring an ambush from the gloom. Rounds are quick, rules are simple, and the “one more game” itch hits hard. GRAVE'S HALLOWWEN TAG! is perfect for spooky party nights with friends.

Content note: frequent darkness and sudden audio/visual jump scares. Uses Godot's UPNP multiplayer so it requires sharing your server IP address.
